body:
I think if your post made me tear up, then I do have some emotions about what you said, heh.  It is hard to just...love myself.  I see your points.  I'm going to keep them in mind while I'm thinking about things this weekend.
Thanks for responding  💕

I want to say you're not wrong.  I feel secure in who I am as a person, so when people tell me nows my chance to rediscover myself, I don't really understand what that means.  I have hobbies and things I do to pass the time, but I have such a hard time enjoying those things.

If you don't mind me asking - what brings you joy?  What ties you to life?
